relations: Gentle wind across the lake surface creates ripples that distort the mirrored reflections of trees and mountains.
Drifting clouds near the mountain peak gradually obscure or reveal the snow-covered summit and alter the sky's light.
The soft pink illumination on the upper clouds shifts subtly as the sun's angle changes during twilight.
Stationary evergreen trees along the shoreline maintain their vertical reflection in the calm water unless disturbed by wind.
